method: Three parts. (1) Clearance: the first pipe at its trial rest pose one sector pitch toward -Y is a fixture of every eject case, so the second delivery's whole trial path is checked against it. (2) Lateral budget: the pipe ends are 169.4 mm apart at nominal docks; with each dock within +/-70 mm the ends stay 29.4 mm apart. (3) Control: the planar trial with the first pipe in the same section, which is what a dock at the wrong sector or a lateral error beyond the budget gives.
finding: With the first pipe in the same section only 24/180 second ejects are captured: the rest stay on the lip against the first pipe or fall short. The second trip therefore needs the sector-B dock inside the lateral budget; with it, the second delivery is the first delivery's physics (the trial is planar).
limits: The sector divider panel, pipe yaw and pipe-end contact are not modelled; G4 measures the lateral dock scatter
